desc.en: A Master of International Management core course taught as a build lab, not a lecture: eleven two-hour Thursday sessions in which teams take one company's five incompatible data sources and give it a KPI tree, a star schema, a pipeline, a tested finding, a dashboard and a churn model — then argue in presentation week that the decision they sealed in October actually changed. desc.en: A demonstration copy of OMBAFR455 with a fictional cohort, for talks on technology in education. Nobody in it is a real student; the back end at /demo/admin.html reads a generated dataset, not this namespace.

courses.$comment: 24 Oct 2026 — the presentation demo (/demo/). Student pages are a copy of SUMAS/ombafr455 with data-course=demo, so anyone who tries the front end registers in the `demo` namespace, never in the real cohort. The demo back end is self-contained (/demo/data.js); this entry exists so login, chat and progress recognise the course and so /admin/ can probe its rules.

project.blurb: Four ratings and two sentences per week, from feedback.html. Anonymous on the room screen (/demo/board.html), named in the dashboard.
